seoDescription: Meet the physical therapists, occupational therapist, athletic trainer and staff at Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness Clinic in Oshkosh, WI.
heroText: Physical therapists, an occupational therapist, a physical therapist assistant, a licensed athletic trainer and the office staff who keep it all running.
introText: We team up with you on your recovery, and we keep rehab effective — and even fun — in a relaxed, professional setting. Our office staff is here for any billing, insurance, or scheduling question.
promiseText: We've been doing this since 1990, and we still treat every patient like they're our only patient. At every appointment you get **hands-on, one-on-one** attention from your therapist. We find what's causing the problem, treat it, and **teach you** how to keep it from coming back.
ctaTitle: Ready To Work With Our Team?
ctaText: Call our Oshkosh clinic to schedule. You don't need a referral, and we accept most insurance, including Medicare.
